description: Bug 1 — XamSecure posture findings massively duplicated in the Security & Alerts cost-drawer tab. In ResourceSecurityAggregationService.xamSecureGroup(...), the POSTURE loop currently de-dupes only by row.getUpwindId(), but the Upwind sync appends one row per historical scan (each with a distinct upwind_id), so the de-dup is a no-op and the user sees the same finding dozens of times (e.g. S3 bucket xamopscftemplate, account 605134457560: 216 FAIL rows across only 5 distinct check_titles). Fix: de-dupe by a stable identity key = normalize(checkTitle!=null?checkTitle:title) + '|' + resourceType + '|' + region, keeping ONE finding per key at the WORST severity in the group and preferring the most-recent row by syncedAt (fall back to lastSeenTime, then first non-null). Independent of FEAT-002 (different file: the aggregator, not the controller). Scoped to xamSecureGroup's posture path ONLY — securityCenterGroup (already fixed in d082b9f05) and the vulnerability-summary path must not change.
steps: Read /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/sec-tab-dedup-sc-fix/.agents/tasks/cost-security-alerts-tab/context.json and this file FIRST. Then read ResourceSecurityAggregationService.java (xamSecureGroup), UpwindPostureFinding.java, UpwindPostureFindingRepository.findFailingByResource, and SecuritySeverity.java.

In ResourceSecurityAggregationService.xamSecureGroup(...), replace the POSTURE loop's upwind_id-only de-dup (Set<String> seenPostureIds / seenPostureIds.add(row.getUpwindId())) with a group-by over a stable key. Build key = normalize(checkTitle!=null?checkTitle:title) + '|' + String.valueOf(resourceType) + '|' + String.valueOf(region), where normalize is a null-safe trim+lowercase. Iterate the rows returned by findFailingByResource across ALL match keys (ARN key then short-id key, same loop structure as today).

For each group key, keep ONE representative row: prefer the row with the most recent syncedAt; if syncedAt is null on one side, fall back to comparing lastSeenTime; if both are null, keep the first row encountered. Track the WORST severity across ALL rows in the group using SecuritySeverity.rank/worstOf (do NOT just take the representative row's severity — the emitted finding's severity must be the worst in the group).

After grouping, emit one ResourceSecurityFinding per surviving key: title = representative.getCheckTitle()!=null ? representative.getCheckTitle() : representative.getTitle(); severity = the worst severity computed for the group; detail/resourceType = representative.getResourceType(); deepLink = new SecurityDeepLink("/xamsecure/posture", Map.of()) (unchanged). Preserve the final sortBySeverity(group) call and leave the VULNERABILITY summary path exactly as-is.

Do NOT loosen findFailingByResource (keep FAIL-only; RESOLVED rows stay excluded). Do NOT inject SecurityService/CloudListService. Do NOT modify securityCenterGroup, complianceOpsGroup, or performanceGroup.

Extend ResourceSecurityAggregationServiceTest: extend the posture(...) helper (or add an overload) to set region, syncedAt and lastSeenTime. Add a test with THREE posture rows sharing the same checkTitle+region+resourceType but different upwindId and syncedAt and differing severities -> assert EXACTLY ONE XamSecure posture finding, carrying the WORST severity (and, if asserted, the most-recent-syncedAt row's title). Add a test with TWO rows of DIFFERENT checkTitle -> TWO posture findings. Stub the vulnerability repo to return empty in these cases so only posture rows are asserted. Keep every existing case in the file green (xamSecureEmitsPostureRowsAndOneVulnerabilitySummary, xamSecureEmptyWhenNoArn, xamSecureFailureIsIsolated, and all Security Center cases).

Compile and run the aggregator test suite; then stage and commit locally on branch fix/sec-tab-dedup-and-security-center with git -C /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/sec-tab-dedup-sc-fix (commit the two changed files only; never push). Set this FEAT's status to completed and record in findings any detail FEAT-002 or the convergence step needs.
acceptance_criteria: For input equivalent to xamopscftemplate (multiple FAIL posture rows sharing checkTitle+region+resourceType, differing upwind_id), the XamSecure group emits exactly ONE posture finding per distinct (checkTitle, resourceType, region) instead of one per row.
The surviving finding's severity is the WORST severity present in its group and its title is the (fallback) check title of the most-recent-by-syncedAt row in the group.

Rows with distinct check_titles still produce distinct findings; RESOLVED rows remain excluded; most-severe-first ordering and the /xamsecure/posture empty-query deep link are preserved; the vulnerability summary path is unchanged.
`mvn -q -pl xamops-service -am test -Dtest=ResourceSecurityAggregationServiceTest` passes with the new and all pre-existing cases green.
findings: DONE. xamSecureGroup POSTURE loop now de-dupes by stable identity key = normalizeKeyPart(checkTitle||title) + '|' + resourceType + '|' + region (normalizeKeyPart = null-safe trim+lowercase, Locale.ROOT; null resourceType/region rendered via String.valueOf). Rows are grouped into a private static PostureGroup helper that (a) tracks the representative as the most-recent row — syncedAt first, falling back to lastSeenTime, keeping the first-encountered row when both are undecidable — and (b) collects ALL severities so the emitted finding carries SecuritySeverity.worstOf(group), NOT the representative's own severity. One ResourceSecurityFinding emitted per surviving key: title = representative.getCheckTitle()!=null?checkTitle:title; resourceType = representative.getResourceType(); deepLink = new SecurityDeepLink("/xamsecure/posture", Map.of()) unchanged. The old Set<String> seenPostureIds / upwind_id de-dup is gone. VULNERABILITY summary path, securityCenterGroup, complianceOpsGroup, performanceGroup, and findFailingByResource (FAIL-only) are untouched. LinkedHashSet import retained (still used by securityCenterGroup). Changed files: xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/security/ResourceSecurityAggregationService.java and xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/security/ResourceSecurityAggregationServiceTest.java (extended posture(...) helper with region/syncedAt/lastSeenTime overload + added Instant import + two new tests: identity-dedup-worst-severity and distinct-checks-stay-separate). VERIFIED: mvn -q -pl xamops-service compile -> BUILD SUCCESS; mvn -q -pl xamops-service -am test -Dtest=ResourceSecurityAggregationServiceTest -> Tests run: 17, Failures: 0, Errors: 0 (all pre-existing cases still green). NOTE for convergence/FEAT-002: because the module build pulls permissions-common via -am and that module has no matching test, the targeted -Dtest run must pass -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false (or run with -pl xamops-service only) to avoid a 'No tests matching pattern' failure in the sibling module; the xamops-service suite itself is clean. Committed on branch fix/sec-tab-dedup-and-security-center (two source files only); not pushed.
